description: Implement a function that inserts a value into a sorted list while maintaining the sorted order. The function has iContract preconditions (list must be sorted) and postconditions (result is sorted, has one more element, and contains the new value).
test_cases:
assert sorted_insert([1, 3, 5], 4) == [1, 3, 4, 5]
assert sorted_insert([], 1) == [1]
assert sorted_insert([2, 4, 6], 1) == [1, 2, 4, 6]
assert sorted_insert([1, 2, 3], 3) == [1, 2, 3, 3]
print('All tests passed!')
